post.summary: Create subscription for specified vehicle material & property data
post.description:
Create subscriptions targeting designated vehicle data including materials, maps and property values. Only mower model LUBA 3 AWD is supported for this subscription capability. The number of devices per request cannot exceed 20. Each subscription is valid for 10 minutes after creation, and you need to re-initiate the subscription after expiration. After calling this subscription interface successfully, you must establish an SSE long connection to receive real-time push data. # SSE Long Connection Access Guide Request Info
Request URL: GET https://api-open.mammotion.com/developer-sse/api/client/sse
Request Method: GET
Response MIME Type: text/event-stream
Mandatory Request Headers
- Authorization: Bearer {your-access-token} // Developer platform identity authentication token - SSE-Client: developer // Fixed client identification value, must be passed unchanged - Accept: text/event-stream // Mandatory header to declare acceptance of SSE streaming data Execution Sequence Requirement
Call this subscription API first (/v1/devices/subscriptions), then establish the SSE connection. No device business data will be pushed if connected in reverse order. Special SSE Push Messages Processing Specification
| Message Content | Message Type | Client Processing Suggestion | |------------------------|--------------------------|--------------------------------------------------------------------------------| | `:: Connect to server successful ::` | Connection initialization message | Mark the SSE link is ready to receive business data | | `:: heartbeat ::` | Periodic heartbeat packet | Directly ignore this message, it is only used for gateway link keep-alive | | `{"pushTag":"sc","pushType":"1"}` | Server side kick-off notification | Gracefully close current connection. DO NOT perform automatic reconnection to avoid infinite connection preemption loops. This case is usually triggered when another SSE connection is established under the same developer account. | Device Error Code Notification
Subscribe with property key `ERR_CODE` to receive messages with `pushTag: notify` and `pushType: 5`. The `pushData` object contains `deviceId`, `code` (error code as a string), and `createTimestamp` (Unix timestamp in milliseconds). ```json {"messageId":"904395319830118400","pushTag":"notify","pushType":5,"pushData":{"deviceId":"OlHl7Hmm6DCsdZq8P5Ap000000","code":"1000","createTimestamp":1762336135279}} ``` Message Notification
Subscribe with property key `MSG_NOTICE` to receive messages with `pushTag: notify` and `pushType: 6`. Connection Timeout & Subscription Rules
1. Idle cleanup rule: The server will actively close connections without any data interaction for 10 consecutive minutes. 2. Subscription expiration handling: Valid for 10 minutes. After expiration, the SSE channel remains online normally, but the server stops pushing business data. Re-call this subscription interface to resume data push. Debug Specification (STRICTLY FORBIDDEN to use built-in web debugging tool on document page)
Using the page-built SSE debugger will generate massive zombie idle connections on the server side, and may kick out your formal running SSE connection under the same account. Please use the following curl command for local debugging: ```bash curl -N \ -H "Authorization: Bearer ReplaceWithYourRealAccessToken" \ -H "SSE-Client: developer" \ -H "Accept: text/event-stream" \ https://api-open.mammotion.com/developer-sse/api/client/sse ``` Common HTTP Status Codes & Connection Closing Causes
- 200 OK: SSE streaming connection established normally - 401 Unauthorized: Token invalid, expired or authentication verification failed - 403 Forbidden: Insufficient access permission to create SSE connection The server actively closes connections for these reasons: subscription expiry, long-term idle timeout, server-side kick-out, manual termination.

taskName.description: Task name. Required when action is START

action.description:
Available device actions. One of the following values:


- `CMD_START` — No plan start mowing immediately. The mower will start working.
- `START` — Start mowing immediately. The mower will start working.
- `PAUSE` — Pause the current mowing operation. Can be resumed later.
- `RESUME` — Resume mowing from a paused state.
- `STOP` — Stop the mower immediately and terminate the current task.
- `RETURN` — Return to the charging dock.
- `CANCEL_RETURN` — Cancel the ongoing return-to-dock command.

deviceId.description: Unique identifier of the target device

properties.description:
Array of property keys to subscribe, supported keys as below:
- `DEV_ST` — Main operating status of the device
- `CHG_ST` — Device charging status
- `SELF_CHK` — Device self-check status code
- `SENS_ST` — Sensor working status
- `LOC_SRC` — Location source status
- `BAT_PCT` — Remaining battery percentage
- `BMS_INFO` — Detailed battery management system data
- `COORD` — Real-time device coordinate position
- `NET_ST` — Network connection information
- `WK_PRG` — Mowing work progress
- `KNF_HGT` — Cutting blade height setting
- `KNF_ST` — Cutting blade running status
- `WK_TRK` — Mowing track trajectory data
- `DEV_VER` — Device firmware version info
- `BASE_STN` — Charging base station status
- `OTA_PRG` — OTA firmware upgrade progress
- `MAP_UPLD` — Map file upload progress
- `LOG_SYNC` — Device log synchronization progress
- `DEV_INF` — Device nickname modification event
- `TSK_CHG` — Work schedule task change event
- `ENR_BIND` — New device binding event
- `ENR_UNBIND` — Device unbinding event

online.description: Online status of the device : 1 indicates online, 0 indicates offline

status.description:
Status of the device. One of the following values:



- `Standby` — Device is idle and ready for operation.
- `Working` — Device is currently performing a task.
- `Paused` — Operation is temporarily paused.
- `Mapping` — Creating or updating the lawn map.
- `Updating` — System firmware is being updated.
- `Offline` — Device is disconnected from the server.
- `Returning` — Returning to the charging dock.
- `Abnormal` — Device has encountered an error or abnormal condition and may require user intervention.
